what: Override baseline seeding is documented only in SKILL.md prose; neither check-plan-size.sh nor design-postplan-emit.sh is tasked to write drift-baseline.env on the validator-Override retained Step 2b.5 path
scenario_or_breakage: Validator defects exit design-postplan-emit at rc 10 before _postplan_run_plan_size, so --snapshot-original never writes the baseline; Override runs standalone Step 2b.5 only, leaving baseline absent and DRIFT_TRIGGER_FIRED=false forever (plan failure mode #308)
suggested_fix: Add a write-once baseline seed to check-plan-size.sh (or design-postplan-emit.sh) when drift-baseline.env is absent after a successful size parse, using BASELINE_PLAN_LINES/BASELINE_DIFF_LINES keys and the same [[ ! -f ... ]] guard; add a harness case in test-check-plan-size.sh
